hotfixes.title: Firmware upgrade: the progress bar now moves (measure the image with wc -c, not stat)
Station mode: an explicit key_mgmt (WPA3 when the AP offers it) and a stuck upstream that now recovers in ~16 s
Firmware Upgrade page: a progress bar and an in-place result while installing fixes
Update checks now retry 15 minutes after a failed manifest fetch instead of waiting 6 hours
Hotfix install retries once when apk cannot see the new version yet, instead of failing on the first press
